name: uscreen-docs
description: The UScreen documentation site (Starlight). `npm run build` writes the generated pages first, then builds the site.

scripts.dev: npm run generate && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro dev
scripts.build: npm run generate && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && node scripts/copy-rustdoc.mjs && node scripts/check-site.mjs
